products.title: Smart Accountant
products.headline: A complete double-entry accounting system, built on IFRS, designed in Arabic from the root
products.summary: It reads your invoices, proposes the balanced entry, and closes the month with you. Built to replace manual data entry — not the accountant.

features.t: A full chart of accounts and journal
features.d: A ledger per account, automatic posting, and upward balance aggregation with the correct sign.
Sales, purchasing, inventory, fixed assets and depreciation, banks, and cost centres.
Employees, attendance, leave, and a monthly payroll run that posts its entries and provisions automatically.
Photograph the invoice with your camera — the system extracts the data and proposes an entry that is balanced and accounting-correct.
A financial health indicator, early alerts, a cash-flow forecast, and «what if» simulation before you decide.
A route guard, a scoped storage layer, and row policies in the database — defence in depth.

modules: Chart of accounts, journal entries, posting, aggregated balances, and a statement per line
Customers, invoices, credit notes, and collections linked to the entries
Vendors, purchase invoices, and payments with automatic posting
Items, movements, and valuation linked to cost accounts
Asset register, periodic depreciation, and disposal with its accounting effect
Employees, attendance, leave, and a monthly payroll run with IAS 19 provisions
Allocating cost and revenue to cost centres at document level
IFRS financial statements and exportable operational reports
Financial health indicator, alerts, cash-flow forecast, and «what if» scenarios
products.countriesNote: The system changes its behaviour entirely by country pack: currency, VAT rate, zakat, weekend days, social insurance rates, and the end-of-service formula.

useCases.d: Sales, purchasing and inventory in one flow, with IFRS reports ready for the auditor.

useCases.t: An accounting firm serving several entities
useCases.d: Full isolation between entities on three layers, and one dashboard for the firm.

useCases.t: An organisation with payroll in more than one country
useCases.d: A country pack per branch: tax, insurance and end of service by each country's formula.

proof.label: payroll and provisions to the standard

architecture: TypeScript end to end — contracts shared between client and server
PostgreSQL with Drizzle ORM and exported, reviewable migrations
Schema validation on every request — no data enters unchecked
Comprehensive automated tests over the critical accounting paths
A natively right-to-left interface with tuned Arabic typography and tabular numerals

cta.label: Request a demo
cta.sub: We run the demo on a case from your own company — not on canned sample data.

film.h: From the photograph to the close. Five steps.
film.lede: The device stays where it is — the scroll tells the story.

chapters.d: A paper invoice, a photo from a phone, or a PDF from email — the document box takes it as it is, with no re-entry.
The system reads the vendor, the date, the net and the tax, and proposes the right account from your own chart of accounts.
A double entry: debit equals credit — or it does not pass. No in-between state, no fixing it later.
On your approval the entry posts to the general ledger, and balances and reports update in the same moment.
IFRS financial statements ready for the auditor, and a monthly close after which nothing changes quietly.

products.title: RahmaCare
products.headline: Smart healthcare in the family's hands — and a record with no number without a source
products.summary: A Flutter app for managing family health with AI, and a relief platform linking a case to a donor through a record that can be verified.

features.t: A beneficiary file with explicit consent
features.d: Consent revocable at any time, and an access log showing the beneficiary who viewed their file.
Every aid item linked to the case with a clear approval path — no number published without a traceable source.

features.t: An assistant that reads the case
features.d: It summarises the indicators and warns early, while the medical decision stays human.
A full path for deaf and non-speaking users — because someone who cannot use the product was not built for.
Health data with role permissions per family member, encrypted in transit and at rest.
Keyboard, screen reader, and measured contrast across the whole app.

useCases.t: A family managing several people's health
useCases.d: Appointments, medicines and reports per person, with different permissions inside the family.
Linking the case to the donor through a signed record that cannot change quietly.

proof.label: of published numbers tied to a source

architecture: Flutter with one codebase for iOS and Android and clean state management
Firebase for sync and authentication, with local storage for offline work
An AI layer inside the task flow, not in a side panel
A general ledger with a serial number and a hash for every action

products.title: AI Lab
products.headline: Agents that carry out real tasks — with clear limits and a human in the loop
products.summary: Data extraction, process automation, and knowledge systems wired to your own data. The difference between a chatbot and an agent is responsibility: the first suggests text, the second changes state in your system.

features.d: Invoices, receipts and contracts — from an image into structured fields ready for approval.
An assistant that answers from your own documents and data, citing the source in every answer.
Agents that run a chain of steps across your systems and stop at the human decision points.
Output accuracy measured before launch, and a log of every decision the agent made.
We pick the model by the task, not the fashion, and the system stays swappable without a rebuild.
What the agent can do is written and tested — and so is what it cannot.

useCases.t: A finance team drowning in invoices
useCases.d: Extraction, classification and a proposed entry — with approval left to a human.

useCases.t: A support team answering the same questions
useCases.d: An assistant built on your documents, with a citation to the source.
